title: Redis Cache Eviction Storm — High Memory Pressure
symptom: Cache hit rate drops below 40%; Redis logs show 'maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru' evictions at high rate; downstream services reporting cache misses and increased DB load.
recommended_action: redis-cli CONFIG SET maxmemory 4gb && kubectl rollout restart deployment/redis
remediation_steps: Check Redis memory stats: redis-cli INFO memory | grep used_memory_human
Inspect eviction count: redis-cli INFO stats | grep evicted_keys
Increase maxmemory limit: redis-cli CONFIG SET maxmemory 4gb
Review eviction policy: redis-cli CONFIG SET maxmemory-policy allkeys-lfu
If cluster, rebalance shards: redis-cli --cluster rebalance <host>:<port>
